title: Ideas
subtitle: A few ways to make the workspace your own.

items.title: A place for each project
items.description: Add a top-level folder for each project. Keep its brief, notes, and saved responses together.

items.title: Let your tools write the updates
items.description: Have your own API or script save results as JSON or Markdown. The interface becomes a window into those files.

items.title: Keep useful results close
items.description: Link a conversation to its source document, checklist, or data file. Everything stays navigable within the workspace.
